create_MonolingualFunctionsMode: create a MonolingualFunctionsMode instance to process monolingual code datasets with BPE tokenization and function extraction
extract_data_for_line: extract standalone and class functions from a JSON line by tokenizing code content with a LangProcessor
learn_bpe: train BPE codes on a 50GB subset of shuffled tokenized data across all languages and suffixes
get_vocab: build a vocabulary from BPE-processed training data using a 20GB subset across all languages
review_MonolingualFunctionsMode: review the MonolingualFunctionsMode class for monolingual function extraction with submitit checkpointing support
